Add-only initialization cannot overwrite an existing snapshot; two-tab race has one winner
Lock cancels pending initialization and key derivation publication

Offline unlock/read and encrypted storage after graceful browser restart
Tampered ciphertext fails closed without modifying snapshot
limitations: Read-only snapshot foundation: no encrypted updates, restore merge or passphrase rotation
Existing plaintext store/exports remain unchanged; no automatic migration
No runtime activation or real customer data
Local handle lock only: no cross-tab broadcast, app lifecycle or idle locking yet
Already returned plaintext copies and JavaScript memory cannot be reliably erased; future UI must clear rendered data
No XSS/hostile-script security guarantee or independent security review
Harness loaded online before offline checks; not installed PWA cold launch
Native transaction abort and graceful restart only; no physical quota, eviction or power-loss guarantee
Whole-screen shake unresolved; navigation reset preserved
